questions.prompt: Why is `exhaustMap` (or `concatMap`) preferred over `switchMap` for polling on a timer?

options.text: switchMap would cancel the in-flight request on every tick, potentially starving slow requests
switchMap cannot be used with timer
exhaustMap runs requests in parallel for speed

questions.explanation: On each tick switchMap cancels the previous request. If requests are slower than the interval, none may ever finish. exhaustMap skips ticks while busy; concatMap queues them.

questions.prompt: Which function replaces the deprecated `toPromise()` to get the FIRST value of an Observable as a Promise?
questions.explanation: firstValueFrom(obs) resolves with the first emitted value (then unsubscribes). lastValueFrom(obs) resolves with the last value on completion. toPromise() is removed in RxJS 8.

questions.prompt: What happens if you call `firstValueFrom` on a stream that completes without emitting any value (and no default)?

options.text: The Promise rejects with an EmptyError

questions.explanation: Both firstValueFrom and lastValueFrom reject with EmptyError on an empty stream. Pass { defaultValue } to resolve with a fallback instead.

questions.prompt: Why can't you use `lastValueFrom` on an infinite stream like `interval(1000)`?

options.text: It resolves only on completion, and an infinite stream never completes
interval is not a valid Observable
It would resolve with the first value instead

questions.explanation: lastValueFrom waits for completion to know the last value. An infinite stream never completes, so the Promise never resolves. Use firstValueFrom or bound the stream.

questions.prompt: What advantage does `fromFetch` have over `from(fetch(url))` inside a switchMap?

options.text: fromFetch aborts the underlying request via AbortController when unsubscribed, so switchMap truly cancels it

questions.explanation: A plain fetch Promise can't be cancelled, so switchMap only ignores its result. fromFetch wires an AbortController and aborts the network call on unsubscribe.

questions.prompt: Which describe correct real-world RxJS patterns? Select all that apply.

options.text: Typeahead: map → debounceTime → distinctUntilChanged → switchMap(request with inner catchError)
Caching a completing request with shareReplay(1)
Using toPromise() to await an Observable

questions.explanation: Typeahead uses switchMap with inner error handling, polling uses exhaustMap + takeUntil, and shareReplay(1) caches completing sources. toPromise() is deprecated/removed — use firstValueFrom/lastValueFrom.
